seg.seg_note: Three segments: RF Communications, Integrated Network Solutions (INS), Government Communications Systems (GCS). Broadcast Communications (sold 4-Feb-2013) and Cyber Integrated Solutions (CIS), both formerly INS, are discontinued operations. Intersegment = "Corporate eliminations" in revenue. Segment orders and funded backlog from the FY2013 10-K (orders printed in $ billions: RF 1.90, INS 1.55, GCS 1.92); unfunded backlog: INS 1,106, GCS 2,504 (RF reports funded only).

ngaap.guidance: FY2014 (initial): GAAP income from continuing operations $4.65 to $4.85 per diluted share; revenue about 1 to 3 percent lower than fiscal 2013.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP income from continuing operations / EPS excludes fourth-quarter FY2013 charges for company-wide restructuring and other actions ($126.7m pre-tax, $83.0m after-tax, $0.74 per share for the year: asset impairments, write-off of capitalized software, facility consolidation, workforce reductions, exit of a product line, and $33.2m loss on prepayment of the 5% notes due 2015). Non-GAAP segment operating income (Table 6): RF 586.1 (+9.2), INS 130.0 (+52.5), GCS 265.2 (+10.5), unallocated corporate expense (67.2) (+21.3). Free cash flow = operating cash flow less capital expenditures (additions of PP&E 164.8 + capitalized software 13.4). No acquired-intangible amortization add-back in this era.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). cf.capex = additions of property, plant and equipment only (164.8); additions of capitalized software (13.4) is a separate line in lines_raw; the release free cash flow deducts both (178.2). Total company orders for the year are not published (the release gives fourth-quarter orders of $1.43 billion only). Self-checks: all pass.
